Nasdaq order block, Friday 6 Nov. 2R to target.

An order block is the last opposite candle before price breaks structure. Nasdaq broke structure, then pulled back into it.

The rule: wait for structure to break, mark the last opposite candle before the break, and enter only when price comes back to it. Stop beyond the block.

GBPUSD fair value gap, Friday 6 Nov. 2R to target.

A fair value gap is a 3-candle imbalance. GBPUSD left one, then came back to it.

The rule: let the gap form, wait for price to trade back into it, and keep the stop beyond the far side of the gap.
